title: Increasing Adverse Drug Events extraction robustness on social media: case study on negation and speculation
reasoning: The paper focuses on improving the robustness and accuracy of Adverse Drug Event (ADE) extraction models using Natural Language Processing (NLP) techniques, specifically against negation and speculation. While pharmacovigilance has ethical implications regarding patient safety, the paper does not benchmark or evaluate religion, morals, or ethics as a core component of its study. Its concerns are about the models' linguistic understanding and prediction accuracy for factual statements in a medical context.
